verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.usebruno.com that indexes markdown versions of the docs, and many doc pages are served as .md. Bruno also publishes agent-oriented integration guides for Cursor, VS Code/Copilot, and Codex, including guidance on adding an AGENTS.md so agents can work with Bruno collections. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.
